monitored_text: Home Newsroom 2025 October Holiday Schedule 2025 October Holiday Schedule Press Release Sep 22, 2025 JLC factories will be closed for holidays from October 1st to 3rd and on October 6th . During this period: Orders can still be placed, and customer service will remain available. Production and shipping schedules will be adjusted. Please plan your orders accordingly based on the following schedule: ·For PCB, PCBA, Stencil, 3D Printing & CNC Orders: Orders placed after 6 PM, September 30th (GMT+8), will begin production on October 4th. ·For Pre-order & Global Sourcing Parts & PCB Layout Service: Service Pause: October 1st to October 8th (GMT+8). Orders and requests will be processed after October 8th. ·Delivery Dates: Delivery dates will be extended accordingly. Please check your order details for the updated lead time. JLC Holiday Schedule Logistics companies Schedule Thank you for your attention and kind cooperation with JLCCNC. We wish you great success and business!
